user.title: Pump and tank
user.description: Choose the pump switch and the distance sensor. Lower distance = fuller tank. Empty distance must be greater than full distance. For ultrasonic meters use values like 0.25 (full) and 0.47 (empty).

data_description.pump_entity: Entity that turns the well pump on/off.
data_description.full_distance: Distance when the tank is full (smaller number).
data_description.empty_distance: Distance when the tank is empty (larger number).

automation.title: Hysteresis and reconciler
automation.description: Suggested thresholds from your calibration: on ≈ {sug_on}, off ≈ {sug_off} (full={full}, empty={empty}). Demand turns ON below the on threshold and OFF above the off threshold after the hold times.

extras.title: Optional features
extras.description: Work/rest cycle (rest=0 = continuous), physical toggles, LED mirrors, and notifications. Leave optional entity fields empty if unused.
